title: RunPlan
description: What the agent must load and for how many laps. Written by core as runplan.json; the agent reads it in the pits. Labels are code names: the plan does not say which setup is the baseline.

revision.description: Increases whenever core rewrites the plan of this experiment.

driver.description: Who drives the laps: the human, or AC's AI on the player's car (Ghost Driver, docs/adr/0014-ghost-driver.md).

ai_hint_share.description: Share of the car's own AI tyre hint the AI drives every block with, instead of the share its calibration learned (docs/adr/0028-run-context-and-ai-provenance.md). Absent: the learned share.

from_order.description: Set once the experiment was stopped (aborted, rejected or reverted): the blocks before this one are abandoned and the agent goes straight to it, a block that puts the baseline back.

label.description: Code name shown to the driver, e.g. Setup K.

laps_target.description: Push laps to drive; 0 means only load the setup.

values.description: Setup item name to raw value, as the setup menu's spinners hold it.
